scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/raw.mp4 --crf=20 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/meetrec-promo.mp4 && npm run subs
scripts.features: for c in Import Speakers Dual; do npx remotion render src/index.ts Feature$c out/raw-$c.mp4 --crf=20 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw-$c.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]setpts=PTS/1.2,fps=30[v];[0:a]atempo=1.2,loudnorm=I=-18:TP=-1.5[a]" -map "[v]" -map "[a]" -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/feature-$(echo $c | tr A-Z a-z).mp4; done
